blocks.name: Hero
blocks.heading: Start a conversation.
blocks.sub: Tell us where the evidence gap is hurting: a stalled deal, an approaching raise, a claim you are no longer sure about. We will come back within two working days.

blocks.name: The form, and what happens next
blocks.heading: What happens next
items: We reply within two working days, from a real person
A 30-minute call to understand the problem, with no deck
If there is a fit, a short written brief with deliverables and pricing
If there is not, we will tell you, and point you somewhere better if we can
blocks.note: Working to a tender or funding deadline? Put the date in your first message and we will tell you honestly whether it is achievable.
